scope: Real component and writer with Chromium CDP touchscreen input; gamepad snapshots are a declared browser API fixture, not physical hardware.

checks.name: two native touch contacts accelerate and turn
lifting steering finger preserves forward contact
pause commits and freezes the real course
opposed simultaneous touches stay neutral from rest
lifting reverse restores the still-held forward contact
pause clears held contacts instead of latching acceleration
new pad held forward cannot launch the vehicle
neutral requirement is visible to the player
neutral then deliberate pad input moves the vehicle
pad disconnect pauses and persists one frozen course
reconnected held pad cannot reapply throttle without neutral
no browser exception in input scenarios
